title: Cozy Entire Home
description:
Relax and enjoy Nashville in this family friendly place to stay. Just 15 minutes from Downtown Nashville. 

Goodlettsville is a quiet town with lots of close by amenities such as our local swimming pool, splash pad and parks such as Peay Park & Moss Wright Park. 

Our local grocery store, Cafe, and antique stores are all within walking distance!

The space
Our home has a large open plan style Kitchen, Dining & living room, it has a separate living space with dedicated office desk for working from home. 

The bedrooms are as follows:
1. Master Bedroom with King size bed & full master bathroom with walk in shower.  

2. Queen Bed room 

3. Double Bed room with a Twin bed also. 

The second full bathroom has a whirlpool bathtub that also has a shower head option for taking a shower or bath. 

our home has 600mbps high speed internet.

There is a separate building on the property, about 50 feet back from the main house that is a separate rental.

Guest access
You can use the entire house.

The yard has a fully fenced in section where your dogs can run free, though that is shared with the other rental building on the land so please check it’s not already being used before going back there.
